source.base: Byte-exact F124-AH graph generator and original source-only first-admissible public causal oracle with only prospectively new cohort globals. Model does NOT use evaluator restore oracle.
source.public_grammar: Every edge role and graph query role declares a single per-graph rel_xor_MASK: or rel_rotl_AMOUNT: operator; transformed source key = rule(original raw source); operator + parameter visible to prediction, not to hidden metadata.
source.source_admission: For each candidate, recover original AH valid pair within source builder only, convert both graphs symmetrically under new declared public operator. Posthoc inverted new public oracle must give positive 1 and negative 0, original literal-key oracle must give 0 positive for every transformed graph, paired token and topology inventories identical.
source.negative_security: Reject if any transformed graph has preexisting equal-key public path; reject positive if no alternate-rule unique route; no label leakage, no protected use.

Yggdrasil.mechanism: ENGINEERED COMPOSITIONAL OPERATOR PARSER from public role syntax: parse public XOR mask / bit-rotation parameter; inverse-transform each raw edge src 16-bit key before original Ygg causal transition model. Train ONLY scalar eta on source-frozen TRAIN. No learned rule semantics or learned parser claim; original 7-active/9-retained weights unchanged.
Yggdrasil.selection: Max TRAIN paired 48 correct, ties choose smallest eta, then run HOLDOUT exactly once. Model parser grammar frozen before any scores.
Yggdrasil.acceptance_guard: Even success means parameterized-program induction via engineered syntax, NOT learned causal relations or general cognition.

Wingless.mechanism: ENGINEERED PUBLIC RELATION PREPROCESSOR at edge input only, map public src bits to expected raw key before original frozen one-state packed 12bit checksum engine. Original states are 1 packed state/node max64; no original model weights changed; no raw16 fingerprint or enlarged retained memory. Compare same rule-normalized graph with and without original 1 packed compression.
